CustomField.description: Marks the address that a seasonal address took over from, so the nightly seasonal swap knows which address to put back when the season ends (R-AD4). Set and cleared by the swap job; there is no reason to edit it by hand.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set by Open Impact when a seasonal address took over from this one. It is cleared when this address comes back into use.
CustomField.label: Replaced By Seasonal
